explanation: The search-bar query is debounced (~50 ms) and the spans grid re-renders asynchronously after the fetch settles, so the test was clicking during a re-render and the element reference was detached.
fix: Capture the unfiltered row count first, assert the count shrank after typing (proving the async fetch settled), and click the row with `{ force: true }`; use the stable `data-test-subj="search-bar-input-box"` selector.
